$title: Gearbox Flange Surface Roughness & Oil Weeping (Valid Personal Test Case)
symptomShortText: Customer reported intermittent oil weeping and high vibration from gearbox housing joint face after 200 hours in operation
quantityExtent: 14 units inspected at customer assembly line

defect.defectText: Flange edge burr and surface roughness above limit

inspections.characteristic: Surface Roughness Ra at sealing joint face

causesIshikawa.causeDescription: Spindle front bearing radial runout exceeded tolerance (0.04mm measured vs max 0.01mm spec)
Aluminium casting batch hardness within nominal spec (85 HB)
Milling feed rate and tool path programmed per standard SOP-MIL-04
Line operator verified clamping torque correctly according to work instruction

fiveWhyChain.question: Why is there oil weeping at the gearbox joint face?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Mating flange cannot form a leak-tight seal due to excessive surface waviness and micro-chatter grooves

fiveWhyChain.question: Why is there surface waviness and micro-chatter?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The face mill cutter vibrates intermittently during the final finishing pass

fiveWhyChain.question: Why does the face mill cutter vibrate?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The milling machine spindle exhibits excessive radial play under cutting load

fiveWhyChain.question: Why does the spindle exhibit excessive radial play?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Pre-load Belleville springs in the front duplex angular bearing set suffered mechanical fatigue

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the bearing springs suffer fatigue before scheduled overhaul?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Preventive maintenance interval was based on calendar months rather than actual spindle cutting hours under heavy machining cycles

actions.actionText: Quarantine 14 affected gearbox housings; 100% optical leak check on customer buffer stock
Overhaul Milling Line 7 spindle: install new matched duplex bearing set and verify radialrunout < 0.005mm
Update SAP PM maintenance strategy: install IoT spindle vibration monitoring and schedule bearing rebuilds at 2,000 runtime hours
